title: Juicy Light Venezuelan Apple Bisque
description: A light and indulgent Venezuelan dish that's perfect for a dinner party. This briny and sweet soup is made with tender apples, onion, and spices.

ingredients.name: apples (Granny Smith and Gala)
ingredients.notes: any combination of sweet and tart apples work well

instructions: In a large pot, boil the chicken broth over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until tender.
Add the apples and spices and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the soup to the pot and add the heavy cream.
Stir to combine and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
